title: Creative Salon Ads to Inspire You (Guide + Examples)

facts.fact: The page gives 'Book Now & Grab 20% Off' as an example call to action for a salon ad.
facts.quote: For example, Book Now & Grab 20% Off is a powerful call to action you can use in your next salon ad.

facts.fact: The page says Facebook ad targeting can use age, gender, interests, and behaviors, and can also target people based on specific life events such as engagement or recently moving.
facts.quote: Their age, gender, interests, and behaviors will help you create highly targeted Facebook ads for salons that have a high chance of converting.

facts.fact: The page states that Google Keyword Planner shows keyword difficulty, cost per click, monthly search volume, and trends throughout the year.
facts.quote: It shows you keyword difficulty, cost per click, and monthly search volume, as well as trends throughout the year.

facts.fact: The page gives 'spa near me', 'hair salon near me', and 'nail salon in [city]' as examples of salon-related search terms people use on Google.
facts.quote: They may search for “spa near me”, “hair salon near me”, and “nail salon in [city]”.

facts.fact: The page suggests a salon with full-time city workers as its target market should be open in the late afternoon and on weekends, when those customers are less busy.
facts.quote: say the target market is full-time workers based in the city. Your salon's operating hours should revolve around their schedule and be open when they're less busy - in the late afternoon and during weekends.

facts.fact: Instagram allows 30 hashtags in a single post, according to the Trafft blog.
facts.quote: What’s more, Instagram allows 30 hashtags in a single post.

facts.fact: The Trafft blog states that small salons may start salon ad budgets at $100–$500 per month and scale up based on results.
facts.quote: Typically, small salons may start with a budget of $100–$500 per month and scale up based on results.

facts.fact: The Trafft blog recommends experimenting with salon hashtags at least once a month.
facts.quote: at least once a month, and see which ones have the most engagement.

facts.fact: Trafft's blog invites readers to sign up for Trafft for free.
facts.quote: Sign up for Trafft for free

The Trafft blog says a salon ad should feature high-quality images, a clear offer or promotion, the services available, booking information, and a strong call to action.
facts.quote: A salon ad should feature high-quality images, a clear offer or promotion, the services available, booking information, and a strong call to action

facts.fact: The page states that Google My Business is a free tool for salon advertising.
facts.quote: Yes, Google My Business is a free and effective tool for salon advertising.

facts.fact: The page lists click-through rate, cost per click, number of appointments booked, and return on ad spend as metrics for tracking salon ad success.
facts.quote: You can track the success of your salon ads through metrics like click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), number of appointments booked, and the overall return on ad spend (ROAS).

facts.fact: The page names Instagram and Facebook as social media platforms for showcasing salon work and running targeted ads.
facts.quote: use social media platforms like Instagram and Facebook to showcase your work, run targeted ads, and offer promotions.
